description.en: Verb-function concept for expressing what a subject does through lexical actions, activities, habits and routines. Action may overlap with Movement when the lexical event itself involves displacement.
description.es: Concepto de función verbal para expresar lo que hace un sujeto mediante acciones léxicas, actividades, hábitos y rutinas. Acción puede superponerse con Movimiento cuando el evento léxico implica desplazamiento.
description.pt: Conceito de função verbal para expressar o que o sujeito faz por meio de ações lexicais, atividades, hábitos e rotinas. Ação pode sobrepor-se a Movimento quando o próprio evento lexical envolve deslocamento.

metadata.notes: v0.2 keeps Action centered on lexical doing: activities, habits and routines. Routine remains an application of Action rather than an independent verb-function. Action may overlap with Movement for verbs such as go, come, walk and run. Tense, aspect, negation, interrogation and modality are grammatical layers that can operate over Action without redefining it.
